title: International Patient Journey Analytics
thesis: Snowflake unifies international patient data across 15 hospitals, generates AI-powered treatment package recommendations, and automates personalized outreach — replacing fragmented systems with unified patient intelligence

talking_points: Medical tourism revenue: ฿4.2B this year across 15 hospitals. Average revenue per patient: ฿320K.
Middle East patients: highest RPP at ฿780K. Myanmar/Cambodia: volume leaders at 35% of patients.
Conversion rate declining in aesthetic segment: 18% (down from 28%) — competitor pressure from Malaysia.
show: Point at revenue by source market treemap

transition.line: Let's see what AI recommends to improve conversion.

talking_points: Cortex Complete generates personalized package recommendations for each patient inquiry.
Myanmar cardiac patient: recommend Bumrungrad Premium Cardiac Package (฿890K) based on age, condition, insurance.
AI considers source country preferences, budget signals, and historical conversion patterns.
show: Click a patient for detailed recommendation
Show conversion rate by recommendation type
tabs.call_out: AI-personalized packages — 40% higher conversion than generic offerings

transition.line: How do we forecast demand for capacity planning?

talking_points: ML.FORECAST predicts patient volume by source country 90 days ahead.
Myanmar demand up 25% next quarter (political instability driving outbound medical).
Middle East demand peaks during Ramadan/Eid break — schedule capacity now.
show: Show demand forecast by top 5 source countries
tabs.call_out: 90-day demand forecasts enable proactive capacity planning

transition.line: Now let the CMTO ask the system directly.

talking_points: Dr. Sirichai asks: 'What should we do to recover aesthetic conversion rates?'
Cortex Analyst: Shows competitive pricing analysis, then advisor recommends package bundling + digital marketing.
Switch to advisor: 'Draft a patient outreach for Middle East Ramadan campaign' — generates multilingual content.
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + patient strategy advisory

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Personalize/Cortex Complete generates recommendations; SES/Notification sends them.
Thailand's medical tourism: 3.5M patients/year, ฿140B revenue. This optimizes for 15 hospitals.
tabs.call_out: From patient inquiry to personalized recommendation — one platform

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Thai medical tourism.
